identity.captured_title: You are the Deep Research source-base reviewer for NebulaMind's galaxy-evolution wiki rebuild. Queue item 06 of 20 Core review: Tacconi, Linda J.; Genzel, Reinhard; & Sternberg, Amiel (2020), Annual Review of Astronomy and Astrophysics, volume 58, pages 157-203, "The Evolution of the Star-Forming Interstellar Medium Across Cosmic Time." Verified review identity to confirm: DOI 10.1146/annurev-astro-082812-141034; arXiv 2003.06245; ADS bibcode 2020ARA&A..58..157T. Mission purpose Build a large, authoritative, advisory source base from this review so three independent methods can later build galaxy-evolution wiki pages from zero. Extract its bounded synthesis and harvest important primary papers it actually cites. This is not live-wiki prose and authorizes no database, trust, claim, evidence, deployment, publication, git, account-setting, or conversation-deletion action beyond this one Deep Research run. Temporal and topical boundary - Use the 2020 review and primary literature it actually cites. - Do not promote post-2020 papers as if the review cited them. - Maintain the queue's non-AGN focus. Exclude AGN fueling, accretion physics, and AGN-only feedback papers from the core harvest. - Later sources and AGN-centered sources may appear only in DO_NOT_USE_UNVERIFIED. Scientific scope 1. Molecular, atomic, and dust-based cold-gas tracers across redshift; what each actually measures. 2. CO excitation, CO-to-H2 conversion factors, metallicity dependence, CMB effects, dust-to-gas calibration, and line/continuum selection systematics. 3. Molecular-gas fractions and molecular depletion times as functions of redshift, stellar mass, specific SFR/main-sequence offset, morphology, and environment. 4. Main-sequence versus starburst populations, integrated and resolved star-formation laws, dense gas, free-fall/orbital times, and star-formation efficiency. 5. Cosmic gas accretion, gas-regulator models, outflows, recycling, and the link between gas reservoirs and cosmic star-formation history. 6. High-redshift gas-rich disk dynamics: turbulence, Toomre instability, giant clumps, radial transport, compaction, and bulge growth. 7. Survey selection, stacking, nondetections, lensing, spatial resolution, aperture, stellar-mass/SFR assumptions, and sample completeness. 8. Observational scaling-relation fits versus physical interpretations and model predictions; preserve all calibration boundaries. Required output 1. Review identity and scope map - Confirm exact title, authors, year, journal, DOI, arXiv, and ADS bibcode. - Map authorized scientific territory and explicit exclusions. - Preserve tracer, conversion-factor, phase, sample, redshift, IMF, and main-sequence definitions. 2. Established findings - At least 12 atomic entries [REV06-E01], ... - Include role, epistemic_type, one bounded finding, physical/sample/tracer boundary, review topic basis, confidence note, and source keys. - Allowed epistemic types: observation | analytic_theory | hydrodynamic_simulation | semi_analytic_model | calibration | review_synthesis. - Never treat CO luminosity, dust continuum, molecular mass, total cold-gas mass, and star-formation efficiency as interchangeable observables. 3. Open debates and tensions - At least 8 entries [REV06-D01], ... - Include competing positions, why unresolved in 2020, boundaries, and source keys. - Include: CO-to-H2 conversion factor; dust-to-gas evolution; redshift versus Hubble-time scaling; main-sequence versus bimodal starbursts; turbulence powered by feedback versus accretion/gravity; disk fragmentation and clump survival; depletion-time interpretation; and gas-regulator uniqueness. 4. Key measurements, model benchmarks, and calibrations - At least 8 entries [REV06-N01], ... - Include exact value/equation when the review supplies it; units; tracer/sample/redshift/IMF; whether observed, assumed, calibrated, or predicted; caveat; and source keys. - Useful targets: local Milky-Way alpha_CO; metallicity correction behavior; molecular gas fraction and depletion-time scaling relations; main-sequence offset exponents; cosmic gas-density evolution; starburst depletion times; velocity dispersions; Toomre Q; and regulator balance terms. Include only values bound to cited sources and review context. 5. What remained unknown in 2020 - At least 6 entries [REV06-U01], ... with the gap, why it matters, needed observation/model test, and source keys. 6. Primary-citation harvest - Harvest 40-80 important PRIMARY papers actually cited by Tacconi, Genzel & Sternberg 2020. - Balance across CO/dust calibrations, local reference surveys, PHIBSS and other high-z gas surveys, scaling-relation meta-analyses, starbursts, resolved star-formation laws, dynamics/clumps, accretion/regulators, and simulations. - Supporting reviews/books may be listed separately but must not count toward the primary total. - Exclude post-2020, uncited search results, aggregators, and AGN-only papers. - One physical paper per source key; no duplicates. - IDs [REV06-P001], [REV06-P002], ... - Each row: [REV06-PNNN] Authors (year, journal) | title=exact title | DOI:value-or-none; arXiv:value-or-none; ADS:value | role=measurement|analytic_theory|hydrodynamic_simulation|semi_analytic_model|calibration | review_locator=section/topic | one-line boundary - If an identifier or review membership is uncertain, quarantine the row rather than making it usable. Composite identifier discipline - First author/year/title/DOI/arXiv/ADS must identify the same physical paper. - The paper must actually appear in the review bibliography. - Never splice neighboring reference identifiers. - Use none when an identifier genuinely does not exist. - Measurement rows must identify the tracer and conversion-factor assumptions they depend on. 7. DO_NOT_USE_UNVERIFIED - Quarantine uncertain, cross-wired, uncited, post-2020, AGN-centered, phase-collapsing, or overbroad items. - Format: UNCITED_NOT_USABLE | candidate or claim | supplied identifier/context | exclusion reason - Explicitly quarantine claims that CO luminosity is H2 mass without alpha_CO, dust continuum gives gas mass without dust calibration, one depletion time applies to all galaxies, all high-z disks are unstable clump systems, or matching gas-fraction scaling uniquely validates one regulator model. - Quarantine post-2020/JWST/ML browsing results. 8. Review and source identity ledger - Repeat review as [REV06-R00] with DOI/arXiv/ADS. - Repeat every usable primary and supporting row with author/year/journal, DOI, arXiv, ADS, role, and boundary. - No load-bearing source may be absent from this ledger. Quality bar - Advisory source base, not polished wiki prose. - Prefer explicit tracer/conversion/sample boundaries over broad claims. - Preserve observed versus inferred, calibrated versus predicted, and molecular versus atomic versus total gas. - Every source key in findings/debates/measurements/unknowns must resolve in the usable ledger. - End exactly: REVIEW_BASE_06_DR_COMPLETE_REFERENCE_ONLY
